         self.assertEqual(count_lines(""), 0)
 
 
+class CharFrequencyTest(unittest.TestCase):
+    def test_empty_input(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency(""), {})
+
+    def test_single_character(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("a"), {"a": 1})
+
+    def test_repeated_characters(self):
+        self.assertEqual(char_frequency("aaa"), {"a": 3})
+
+    def test_mixed_characters(self):
+        result = char_frequency("hello")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"h": 1, "e": 1, "l": 2, "o": 1})
+
+    def test_case_sensitive(self):
+        result = char_frequency("Aa")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"A": 1, "a": 1})
+
+    def test_whitespace(self):
+        result = char_frequency("a b c")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"a": 1, " ": 2, "b": 1, "c": 1})
+
+    def test_newlines_and_tabs(self):
+        result = char_frequency("a\nb\tc")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"a": 1, "\n": 1, "b": 1, "\t": 1, "c": 1})
+
+    def test_unicode_characters(self):
+        result = char_frequency("café")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"c": 1, "a": 1, "f": 1, "é": 1})
+
+    def test_unicode_emoji(self):
+        result = char_frequency("😀😀🎉")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"😀": 2, "🎉": 1})

+        result = char_frequency("hello世界")
+        self.assertEqual(result, {"h": 1, "e": 1, "l": 2, "o": 1, "世": 1, "界": 1})
+
+    def test_numbers_and_symbols(self):
+        result = char_frequency("1!1@2#")

+

+def char_frequency(s):
+    """Return a dict mapping each character to its occurrence count."""
